description: Return one listed credit card in full: fee, APR, intro APR, rewards and category rates, welcome bonus and requirement, perks and credits, foreign transaction fee, the issuer's own application-rule wording when published, and source freshness. Accepts a card id (issuer:slug), slug or name; an unknown card returns a structured error with suggestions.
